rules.interaction: Screening fee is not 'security' under Civ. Code 1950.5.
rules.title: Application screening fee cap of $30, CPI-adjusted (AB 1170 version)
rules.requirement: A landlord may charge an application screening fee only for real costs, never more than $30 per applicant (adjusted for CPI), and only if a unit is or will be available. The landlord must give an itemized receipt and refund unused amounts, and the fee process must follow first-come order or refund non-selected applicants.
rules.coverage_conditions: Landlords and agents charging applicants (including guarantors) to screen a residential rental application
rules.quoted_span: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant.

notes: Effective date is the AB 1170 amendment (2026-01-01); the $30 cap itself dates from before 1998. The text gives no current CPI-adjusted dollar figure.
